title: Why Some Skills Earn 10x More

beats.say: Most people trade time for money and wonder why they're stuck. Alex Hormozi found the math that changes everything.
beats.visual: A lone person walking down a grey concrete sidewalk, low angle, dusk lighting, silhouetted against a tall glass building.

beats.say: It's called the Value Equation. Stay with me, because this formula dictates who gets rich and who stays broke.
beats.visual: A minimalist black desk with a single brass lamp casting a warm pool of light on a blank sheet of paper.

beats.say: Value equals dream outcome multiplied by perceived likelihood, divided by time and effort.
beats.visual: A hand holding a classic fountain pen poised over a dark notebook, shallow depth of field.

beats.say: If you want to charge more, you've got to pull four levers. Most people only focus on one.
beats.visual: Four smooth river stones stacked neatly in a vertical balance on a dark wooden table.

beats.say: Lever one: the dream outcome. People don't pay for the process. They pay for the destination.
beats.visual: A close-up of a vintage brass compass resting on a worn leather map, soft side lighting.

beats.say: Lever two: perceived likelihood. Can you prove it works? Proof kills doubt and drives up your price.
beats.visual: An old hourglass with dark sand pouring steadily through the narrow glass neck, dark moody background.

beats.say: Lever three is time. The faster you deliver the result, the more you can charge.
beats.visual: A sleek silver pocket watch resting open on a dark slate surface, macro shot.

beats.say: Lever four: effort and sacrifice. Make the process feel effortless for the client, and they'll hand over cash.
beats.visual: A heavy iron key lying on a dark wooden plank, dramatic overhead shadows.

beats.say: But here's the catch nobody mentions. These are active business frameworks. About 1 in 5 US businesses close in year one.
beats.visual: A modern coffee shop interior, blurred figures walking past a large window on a rainy afternoon.

beats.say: Passive income comes later, if ever. Hormozi's results took years of brutal 80-hour weeks.
beats.visual: A closed laptop on a dark wooden table with a ceramic mug next to it, minimalist aesthetic.

beats.say: Your move this week? Audit your current work. Which of the four value levers are you ignoring?
beats.visual: A person's hands typing on a mechanical keyboard, shot from directly above in low light.

beats.say: Adjust them, and that's exactly how
beats.visual: A pair of hands sliding a dark leather notebook closed on a clean desk.

caption: Most people trade time for money and wonder why they're stuck. Master the value equation to fix your income. #MoneyPsychology #PersonalFinance #WealthBuilding #AlexHormozi #BusinessTips
description: Alex Hormozi's Value Equation breaks down why some people charge 10x more for the same skill. Learn how to pull the four levers of value in your career.
first_comment: Which of the four levers do you think is easiest to pull in your current job?
